name: Lagos Controlled First-Flush Control
purpose: Control and document diversion of the initial runoff fraction before a collection window may open. This gate does not establish water quality, premium status, regulatory approval, or completed harvest.
evidence_requirements: start and completion timestamps with timezone
instrument and calibration references where applicable
transition_rules: READY requires valid upstream authorization, site match, collector readiness and an approved first-flush method.
DIVERSION_ACTIVE begins only after the first-flush control is physically placed in diversion mode and the action is recorded.
DIVERSION_COMPLETE requires threshold completion evidence and no unresolved control fault.
COLLECTION_ELIGIBLE may be entered only after successful diversion and explicit gate review.
COLLECTION_ELIGIBLE authorizes transition to controlled collection; it is not evidence that collection occurred.
Any material provenance, equipment, safety, timing or contamination concern forces HOLD or FAILED.
fail_closed_conditions: first-flush device unavailable or configuration mismatch
threshold method absent, ambiguous or unapproved
